C-48.Name: What's New once after an update, and an App Store review request
C-48.Summary: G10 of the MarkView gap plan. A What's New sheet opens once on the first launch of a new version (never on a fresh install), and the App Store build asks for a rating through the system sheet after enough successful use.

Problem.Description: Users never learn what changed; the App Store has no ratings. Mockups approved 2026-10-15 («ок»): https://claude.ai/artifact/S4JQJpq9jkfagKwW5tYpc7 boards 3 and 5.

Goals.R-1: What's New: persisted lastSeenVersion; on launch, if a previous version was recorded and differs from the running version → show the sheet once (max 4 items per version, content per release in all 10 languages, "See the guide" opens the Guide at that version's section, Continue/Esc close); a fresh install records the version silently. Help › What's New reopens it any time. The welcome-screen footer link "What's new in X" shows for 7 days after an update.
Goals.R-2: Review request, App Store build only: SKStoreReviewController (macOS) via a small Rust command; asked after the 5th successful session across at least 3 distinct days; never on first launch, never in the same session as an update or a recent error, never while a modal is open; a "successful session" = a document opened and saved or a live reload applied, no crash. Help › Rate Mark… opens the App Store review page in the App Store build. Desktop edition: nothing.

C-48.Dependencies: C-40 Guide (deep link), C-46 welcome footer, m048 build mode (app-store flag).

Constraints.Constraint: No network calls; no tracking; Apple decides whether the review sheet actually shows.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Upgrade 2.3.0 → 2.3.1 shows the sheet once; a fresh install does not; the review request fires only under the rules and only in the App Store build.

AffectedAreas.M-011: whatsNew sheet, session counters, Help menu

C-48.VerificationIntent: Unit tests for the version gate and the review rules (fake clock); e2e for the sheet; cargo test for the command stub on non-app-store builds.
